title: CEC row LIVE: Reward Gyanesh Kumar with Bharat Ratna for delivering West Bengal to BJP, says Jammu and Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah
description: "Padma Bhushan? Why stop there? Give him the Bharat Ratna! One or two years left for the presidential election? Make him the President! Now that he has done so much for the BJP," says Jammu and Kashmir CM Omar Abdullah
